subject: general
question: Which of the following is a property of liquids?

options.text: The rate of diffusion of liquids is higher than that of solids.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The rate of diffusion of liquids is higher than that of solids.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Liquids have no fixed shape but take the shape of the container they are in.
 
• Liquids have a definite volume but no fixed shape.
 
• The intermolecular forces in liquids are weaker than in solids, allowing for higher rates of diffusion.
 
• The rate of diffusion in liquids is higher than that in solids due to the greater mobility of liquid molecules.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Diffusion**

 
 
• Diffusion is the process by which molecules spread from areas of high concentration to areas of low concentration.
 
• In liquids, diffusion occurs faster than in solids because the molecules are more mobile.
 
• Temperature affects the rate of diffusion; higher temperatures increase the rate.
 
 
 
• **Intermolecular Forces**
 
 
• Intermolecular forces are forces of attraction or repulsion between neighboring particles (atoms, molecules, or ions).
 
• In liquids, these forces are weaker than in solids, enabling easier movement of particles.
 
 
 
• **Fluidity**
 
 
• Fluidity is the ability of a substance to flow and take the shape of its container.
 
• Liquids and gases exhibit fluidity, with liquids being less compressible than gases.
 
 
 
• **Viscosity**
 
 
• Viscosity is a measure of a liquid's resistance to flow.
 
• Liquids with high viscosity flow slower than those with low viscosity.
